newsitem.title: UK: Currency, holidays subdue Europe raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Currency, holidays subdue Europe raw cotton.

text.p: Currency fluctuations and holidays inhibited buying by most European mills but some traders saw a rebound in demand after the holidays as they believed mills still needed a fair volume for shipment in late summer/early autumn.
Scant enquiry in evidence focused on remnant supplies from central Asian 1996/97 crops and on prospects for business in Mediterranean cottons.
Purchasing has also continued of West African new crops for shipment from the turn of the year.
